name: Zion Combat: Stand Against the Dark
summary:
- **Stand.** Meet a blow with your raised forearm at the right moment and turn it back in a burst of gold.
- **Your body is the controller.** Punch, and light flies to the one you aim at. Thrust an open palm to Repel, clap for a Thunderclap, point to Rebuke, slash for the Sword of the Spirit. Cross your arms and fling them open for Breakthrough, roll your fists to Bind, hold a ball of light and thrust a Zoe Blast, crouch and Arise.
